answer: Operator-Linked Identity Freeze: each agent identity is tied to an off-chain operator record and a quartz-timestamped audit log of its actions. If a gale of new identities from one operator is flagged, enforcement freezes every identity that operator controls, not just the flagged wallet. The operator must post a relic—a forfeitable deposit held against future identities—before any are unfrozen, and each flagged identity adds a fixed fee drawn from that deposit. Cost to attacker: the full deposit plus per-identity fees, scaling with every sybil created.
